sample_unit: medical students (study 2); 5 scenarios rated by 5 experts (study 1)
unlisted_practices: Comparing generative AI mentor responses against senior student mentors using expert rubric ratings
Student trial using technology acceptance model questionnaire for AI educational mentor

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based mentor for medical students in clinical clerkships, testing it both in a vignette evaluation and a 1-week prospective trial with medical students, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
